prompts.name: new_map
prompts.title: New map
prompts.description: Start a new random map script from your idea.

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: What the map should be like.

prompts.name: finish_map
prompts.title: Finish map
prompts.description: Check a finished-looking map over many seeds and report.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The script, relative to the open folder.

prompts.text: The map in {file} looks finished to me. Run run_quality_check on it with 50 seeds over the settings it is meant for. Fix what fails: rerun only the failed cases while fixing, then once in full. Look at get_picture with view bases and at a contact_sheet. Then give me a short report: the seeds and numbers you checked, the risks that remain, and what only a game test can judge.

prompts.name: teach_me
prompts.title: Teach me
prompts.description: Learn random map scripting step by step.

prompts.name: explain_script
prompts.title: Explain script
prompts.description: Have a script explained section by section.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The script, relative to the open folder.

prompts.text: Explain the script {file} to me. Read it, then explain its sections and what each part places on the map. Generate it once and use inspect_map with sources: true to tie script lines to what they create; show pictures where they help. Use plain words, and use lookup_reference for the commands you name.
